title: Belrose Circle Bonus Points Allowance Table
content:
# Belrose Circle Bonus Points Allowance Table

Bonus points under the Belrose Circle Membership Programme are the points granted when the membership begins earning, in the member's birthday month, on the anniversary of the membership and for each referral who makes a first purchase; each tier fixes the size of each bonus and how many referrals may be rewarded in one membership year.

## Allowances by tier

| Tier | Welcome bonus (points) | Birthday bonus (points) | Anniversary bonus (points) | Referral bonus (points, per rewarded referral) | Referrals rewarded per membership year |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Belrose Circle Member | 250 | 100 | 0 | 500 | 2 |
| Belrose Circle Silver | 500 | 250 | 250 | 750 | 3 |
| Belrose Circle Gold | 1000 | 500 | 500 | 1000 | 4 |
| Belrose Circle Platinum | 2500 | 1000 | 1500 | 2000 | 6 |
| Belrose Circle Black | 7500 | 2500 | 4000 | 4000 | 8 |
| Belrose Circle Founders' Club | 25000 | 7500 | 12000 | 10000 | 12 |

## Basis questions answered

**What is the welcome bonus at each tier?** 250 points at Belrose Circle Member, 500 at Belrose Circle Silver, 1000 at Belrose Circle Gold, 2500 at Belrose Circle Platinum, 7500 at Belrose Circle Black and 25000 at the Belrose Circle Founders' Club, granted when the membership begins earning.

**Is there an anniversary bonus at Belrose Circle Member?** The anniversary allowance at Belrose Circle Member is 0 points. Every other tier carries an anniversary allowance: 250 at Belrose Circle Silver, 500 at Belrose Circle Gold, 1500 at Belrose Circle Platinum, 4000 at Belrose Circle Black and 12000 at the Belrose Circle Founders' Club.

**How much is a referral worth, and how many are rewarded?** Each rewarded referral is worth 500 points at Belrose Circle Member, 750 at Belrose Circle Silver, 1000 at Belrose Circle Gold, 2000 at Belrose Circle Platinum, 4000 at Belrose Circle Black and 10000 at the Belrose Circle Founders' Club. The number of referrals rewarded in one membership year is 2, 3, 4, 6, 8 and 12 respectively, in the same tier order.

**What is the birthday bonus?** 100 points at Belrose Circle Member, 250 at Belrose Circle Silver, 500 at Belrose Circle Gold, 1000 at Belrose Circle Platinum, 2500 at Belrose Circle Black and 7500 at the Belrose Circle Founders' Club, granted in the member's birthday month.

## Allowance drawn in full (hypothetical)

A Belrose Circle Platinum member who has 6 referrals rewarded in a membership year has drawn the whole Belrose Circle Platinum referral allowance for that year, 2000 points for each of them; at Belrose Circle Gold the same year's allowance closes at the 4th rewarded referral.
